messages:
Leah (Finance): Heads-up — our March GCP Marketplace payout is showing a ~$28k shortfall vs the Marketplace statement. Can someone pull the consumption CSV and reseller breakdown? :eyes:
Omar (Infra Ops): on it. I pulled the raw export earlier: gs://redwood-billing/marketplace/gcp/2026-03-01_2026-03-31.csv — has the usage and SKU-level rows.
Priya (Billing): @Omar can you attach the specific rows for marketplace SKUs in europe-west1 and us-west2? We suspect a region mapping/gcp sku id mismatch with the reseller report.
Omar (Infra Ops): pasted a small extract below (filter: product = \"Compute (GPU capacity) - Marketplace\"):
```
invoice_id,sku,gcp_sku_id,region,usage_amount,currency,amount_usd
INV-2026-03-01,redwood_gpu_p100,gcp:ABC123,us-west2,1200,HUSD,14400
INV-2026-03-01,redwood_gpu_p100,gcp:ABC123,europe-west1,800,EUR,9600
INV-2026-03-01,redwood_reserved_commit,gcp:RES-01,global,0,USD,0
```
Leah (Finance): Thanks. The reseller (CloudBridge) statement we received lists only 80% of europe-west1 usage for March — that's where the ~€8k gap comes from after their commission adjustments.
Tim (Partnerships): I pinged Ben at CloudBridge earlier — he said they applied an upstream credit from a legacy committed capacity adjustment from Feb and netted it against March payouts. He promised to send the adjustment memo but I haven't seen the doc yet.
Ben (Reseller - CloudBridge): Sorry — sending the memo now. We applied a one-time commitment true-up for one enterprise customer (acct: cb-enterprise-42) that had a double-billing entry in Feb. We deducted the upstream credit from March payouts per our reseller agreement section 4.2. Sending CSV and the credit note: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/commitment-trueup.csv
Priya (Billing): Can you confirm the invoice IDs and which SKUs were included in the credit? We need to tie that back to GCP invoice ids to comply with our audit trail.
Ben (Reseller - CloudBridge): The credit referenced GCP invoice INV-2026-02-14 and affected sku gcp:ABC123 in europe-west1 only. Amount was -€8,200. I can provide a signed statement.
Leah (Finance): If that's true we still need to reconcile exchange rates and our marketplace fees — the payout feed we get from GCP is in USD. Priya, can you run a quick convert of the -€8,200 at the 2026-03-01 bank rate?
Priya (Billing): Doing that now. Bank FX rate 2026-03-01 = 1 EUR = 1.085 USD per treasury feed. That credit converts to -$8,897.
Omar (Infra Ops): Note: reserved_commit rows show zero usage this month because reserved capacity metered differently (we bill marketplace consumption). Could there be double-counting if CloudBridge credited reserved vs consumption?
Tim (Partnerships): Good point. Ben, the reseller credit language referenced a \"reserved capacity true-up\". Was the credit for reserved capacity fees or for consumption?
Ben (Reseller - CloudBridge): It was for reserved capacity (customer downgrade from 8xV100 to 4xV100 mid-Feb). We applied the adjustment against their March payout because contract allowed offset. I can reissue as a customer-facing invoice instead of netting against Redwood payout if you prefer.
Leah (Finance): We prefer a customer-facing invoice (so Redwood's payout stays untouched) — can you reissue? If not, we'll need the signed adjustment memo + mapping to the exact GCP invoice lines and the marketplace subscription ids.
gcp-billing-bot: Automated notice — marketplace payout feed (batch id 2026-03-31-B) processed 2026-04-05 07:22 UTC. File: /var/tmp/marketplace_payout_2026-03-31.csv
Priya (Billing): If Ben reissues as a vendor invoice we'll need: reseller invoice id, customer account id, original GCP invoice id, SKU ids, region tags, and signed reseller T&Cs excerpt. Please attach to this thread.
Ben (Reseller - CloudBridge): Will do. Expect the reissued invoice + mapping by EOD PT.
Omar (Infra Ops): FYI I'm also checking logs for any duplicated meter ids in europe-west1 for Feb–Mar. If we find duplicates we'll flag with GCP support.
Leah (Finance): Thanks everyone. Action items: Ben to reissue invoice or provide signed memo (Ben). Priya to confirm USD conversion and update ledger (Priya). Omar to check meter duplication (Omar). Tim to stay on the vendor comms. We'll do a quick 15m sync tomorrow 1500 PT if docs aren't in by EOD. :thumbsup:
